subject.title: Gateway memory growth due to repeated file read errors

question: Should the remaining fix target the scheduled producer that asks to read invalid workspace paths, or should OpenClaw change generic read-tool semantics for directory paths?
rationale: Source shows one missing-file class is already handled while directory reads still fail as normal file reads; choosing to list directories instead would change a model-facing tool contract.

options.title: Fix Producer After Live Repro
options.body: Confirm the current scheduled producer and repair its workspace path guidance while preserving existing read-tool semantics.

options.title: Broaden Read Tool Semantics
options.body: Make directory reads return listings, accepting a broader model-facing tool behavior change with focused compatibility coverage.

options.title: Defer Until More Logs
options.body: Wait for current-release gateway logs or a live reproduction before choosing the repair boundary.

recommendation.title: Fix Producer After Live Repro
recommendation.body: Confirm the current scheduled producer and repair its workspace path guidance while preserving existing read-tool semantics.
